# Raw nominal superclass constructor substitutions

Independently authored Base<A,B> and Child extends Base<Object,Map> retain the
same source/map/config inputs in their original superclass call. A separate Type
input is stored after the parent returns. The raw Map supplies no key/value
binding and is never inspected, copied or wrapped.

Source and SDK modes compile all emitted definitions and retain original roles,
Signatures, Exceptions and helpers. Frozen observers repeat sixty fresh-JVM cases
twice and check nulls, aliases, untouched maps/types, callback and field-store
order, late global mutation and exact failures. Independent wrong programs and
same-Code metadata controls precede acceptance; no private code is executable.


The any and closed wildcard-target variants retain a scoped child formal beside
Map<?,?> or Map<? extends String,? super String> in the superclass. Constructor
parameters witness both substitutions in their original scope. An explicit raw
inherited-field cast preserves the original Map check. Source and SDK variants
reuse the frozen observer and twenty wrong programs; ten same-Code controls
reject unknown/crossed formals, changed erasures and generic constructor throws.
